correction_accepted: The cluster is not historical accumulation. It begins at R9, when the project moved from model fitting to algorithms. M1, M2 and R1-R8 are the fitting era; R9 onward is the algorithm era.

universal_root.assessment: This is the contract boundary, not incidental coupling. Everything downstream is defined against it, which is why a registry change had to be layered rather than edited.

components.signature: no CLI, no artefacts written — pure computational modules consumed by synthesisers

THE_KEY_FINDING_FOR_LAUNCH.observation: The runtime surface is 1 module out of 20. The other 19 are research instrumentation.
THE_KEY_FINDING_FOR_LAUNCH.implication: The cluster is not the product. It is the evidence machinery that justifies the product's claims. At launch the shippable runtime is very small, which is a strength, not a shortfall.
THE_KEY_FINDING_FOR_LAUNCH.consequence: Launch readiness is not gated on the cluster. It is gated on the runtime path plus the four items in the development-state plan.

optimisation_targets.problem: Three R9 scripts still import the fitting era: analyze_participant_responses_r9 and generate_user_study_pack_r9 pull flavor_backend, audit_semantic_integrity_r9 pulls flavor_m2_r1. That is why running any of them requires sklearn, scipy and lxml.
optimisation_targets.why_it_matters_at_launch: It puts a heavy scientific stack behind modules that are conceptually algorithm-era. The runtime must not inherit it.
optimisation_targets.recommendation: Assert and test that the runtime path imports neither flavor_backend nor flavor_m2_r1. Leave the three research scripts as they are; they are not shipped.

optimisation_targets.problem: Two top-level synthesisers overlap. analyze_semantic_phylogeny_r9 and analyze_semantic_structure_r9 both consume analyze_descriptor_relations_r9 and descriptor_feature_extraction_r9, then diverge: phylogeny adds FCA, profile assignment and trajectory; structure adds association, evidence structure and tripartite.
optimisation_targets.assessment: Not redundant, but the split is by lineage rather than by question. Nothing states which one answers what.
optimisation_targets.recommendation: Document the division rather than merge it. Merging would create one very large module and lose the ability to run half the analysis.

optimisation_targets.problem: output_generator_round2 now overlaps output_policy_r9.adapt_output. Two modules can produce an OUT_SEPARATED shape, and nothing declares which is authoritative.
optimisation_targets.why_it_matters: This is exactly how a project ends up with two behaviours that diverge silently.
optimisation_targets.recommendation: Declare output_policy_r9.adapt_output as the FROZEN R9 behaviour, retained for historical comparison only, and output_generator_round2 as the current product path. Record it in the contract so a later reader cannot guess wrong.

optimisation_targets.problem: The seven component modules write no artefacts and have no CLI, so they are only ever exercised through a synthesiser. A defect inside one surfaces as a wrong number three layers up.
optimisation_targets.evidence: This is how the operator's own F12 claim went wrong: a proxy measurement three layers from the code under test.
optimisation_targets.recommendation: Give each component a direct unit test against a small fixture. Seven tests, and they make the components independently trustworthy.

modules: output_generator_round2 (main / secondary / overall_profile under the 3+2+3 budget)
flavor_backend.question_bank and select_next_question (information gain, no fitted model)
does_not_need: sklearn or scipy on the output path
what_the_launch_runtime_actually_is.single_remaining_fitted_dependency: rank_candidates, used only to choose which class members to present as options — ROUND2-F4
what_the_launch_runtime_actually_is.assessment: This is a reasonable launch shape. Small runtime, declared rules, no model serving, and every claim traceable to an audit that already exists.

honest_reservation.point: The cluster's 19 research modules were all validated against R8/R9 frozen states, and those root artefacts are lost.
honest_reservation.consequence: The instrumentation still runs, but it can no longer reproduce the numbers it originally reported. It measures the present, not the change from the baseline.
honest_reservation.action: Freezing a new baseline is listed in the development-state plan as a pre-split requirement. It matters more for this cluster than for the runtime, because the cluster's entire purpose is comparison.
